name: clean-submit-goes-all-the-way
spec_quote: a submit run with no problem at all → `press` (the platform presses the button). / Status `submitted` → a confirmation screenshot exists in the folder, the tracker row is written (sync), every tab of that posting is closed.

name: already-submitted-submit-skipped
spec_quote: An application folder that already has a `submitted` result is never run again: the run prints "already submitted" and stops; nothing is written to the results ledger.

name: already-submitted-dry-skipped
spec_quote: An application folder that already has a `submitted` result is never run again: the run prints "already submitted" and stops; nothing is written to the results ledger.

name: already-submitted-beats-bad-materials
spec_quote: An application folder that already has a `submitted` result is never run again: the run prints "already submitted" and stops; nothing is written to the results ledger.

name: materials-fail-submit-blocked-before-form
spec_quote: in a SUBMIT run: the run stops before filling; ONE results line with status `blocked`, `stopped_at` = `common_gate`; the folder is queued once for Joey; the form is never opened; nothing is pressed.

name: materials-fail-dry-reported-but-still-filled
spec_quote: in a DRY run: the problem is kept and reported at the end, the form is still filled and read back; nothing is queued. AMBIGUOUS: the spec does not say explicitly whether the kept materials problem also yields `stopped_at` = `common_gate` in a dry run (it is a common problem, and "a clean dry run has `stopped_at` = null" implies a non-clean one does not), so `common_gate` is the reading taken here.

name: materials-fail-submit-presses-inside-never-opens-form
spec_quote: in a SUBMIT run: the run stops before filling; ONE results line with status `blocked`, `stopped_at` = `common_gate`; the folder is queued once for Joey; the form is never opened; nothing is pressed.

name: platform-problem-blocks-at-platform-page
spec_quote: any platform problem or unknown question → do not press; `stopped_at` = `platform_page`; / In a submit run that does not press, the status becomes `blocked` and the folder is queued for Joey once.

name: unknown-question-submit-blocks-at-platform-page

unknown: Do you now or will you ever require sponsorship?

name: unknown-question-dry-never-presses-never-queues

AMBIGUOUS: the spec never states the literal status string a dry-run results line carries (the mode/decision name `dry-run` is used here), nor whether an unknown question in a dry run still sets `stopped_at` = `platform_page`.

name: canon-mismatch-submit-blocks-at-common-gate

name: batch-not-approved-submit-blocked

name: clean-dry-run-no-press-no-stop

name: captcha-on-platform-page-no-press

AMBIGUOUS: the gate section says "In a submit run that does not press, the status becomes `blocked`" while the closing section lists captcha/needs-user as statuses that reach the results line; the platform-reported status is taken here, but either string is defensible.

name: needs-user-on-platform-page-no-press
